title: Telepathy Tapes: nonverbal autistic children who know Egyptian hieroglyphics
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Telepathy Tapes: nonverbal autistic children who know Egyptian hieroglyphics, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they come out like they know certain Egyptian hieroglyphics and stuff

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking in an interview that also involves a man named Kai Dickens, brings up The Telepathy Tapes, a podcast about autistic children who cannot speak. According to Michels, some of these children come out seeming to know certain Egyptian hieroglyphics, the picture writing of ancient Egypt, and other things. He raises it because, if true, it would suggest knowledge reaching the mind by some route other than ordinary learning.
